require "test_helper"

class RefundTest < Minitest::Test
  def test_amount_cents_computes_a_percentage_of_the_order_total
    refund = Refund.new(order_total_cents: 10_000)
    assert_equal 2_500, refund.amount_cents(25)
  end

  def test_amount_cents_rejects_a_percent_outside_0_to_100
    refund = Refund.new(order_total_cents: 10_000)
    assert_raises(ArgumentError) { refund.amount_cents(150) }
  end
end

#!/usr/bin/env ruby
require "fileutils"
require "open3"

class VerifyChange
  USAGE = <<~TEXT
    Usage: bin/verify-change [BASE] [--test FILE]...

    Checks only the code changed since the merge base of BASE and HEAD
    (BASE defaults to origin/main, then main, then master):

      1. lint on the changed Ruby files, in the project's style guide
      2. the tests for the changed files, plus every --test FILE, with coverage on
      3. patch coverage of the changed lines (simplecov patch)
      4. mutation testing of the changed lines (mutineer, operators from .mutineer.yml)
      5. CRAP scores of the changed methods (bin/crap)

    Runs RSpec specs in a project with spec/ and .rspec, spec/spec_helper.rb,
    or spec/rails_helper.rb, or with rspec, rspec-core, or rspec-rails under
    DEPENDENCIES in Gemfile.lock, and Minitest tests otherwise. Warns when
    both test/ and spec/ exist. Pass --test for the integration or system
    tests of a feature the change touches.

    A lint failure is reported but does not stop the other checks. Lint is
    skipped, not failed, with no style guide, two style guides, no changed
    Ruby files, or the linter gem missing from Gemfile.lock.

    Exit codes: 0 verified, 1 a check failed, 2 usage or git error.
  TEXT

  PATCH_COVERAGE_MINIMUM = 100
  MUTATION_THRESHOLD = 75
  CRAP_THRESHOLD = 30
  TESTS_STEP = "Tests with coverage"
  LINT_STEP = "Lint"
  DEFAULT_BASES = %w[origin/main main master].freeze
  ALL_OPERATORS = %w[arithmetic comparison boolean_connector boolean_literal statement_removal return_nil
                      literal_mutation condition_negation string_literal regex collection_method].freeze
  SOURCE_PATH = %r{\A(app|lib|tools)/.+\.rb\z}
  RSPEC_DEPENDENCY = /^  rspec(-core|-rails)?(\s|!|$)/

  Suite = Data.define(:name, :folder, :test_path, :locations, :suffix)
  MINITEST = Suite.new(name: "Minitest", folder: "test/", test_path: %r{\Atest/.+_test\.rb\z}, suffix: "_test.rb",
                       locations: { %r{\Aapp/} => ["test/"], %r{\Alib/} => ["test/", "test/lib/"], %r{\Atools/} => ["test/tools/"] })
  RSPEC = Suite.new(name: "RSpec", folder: "spec/", test_path: %r{\Aspec/.+_spec\.rb\z}, suffix: "_spec.rb",
                    locations: { %r{\Aapp/} => ["spec/"], %r{\Alib/} => ["spec/", "spec/lib/"], %r{\Atools/} => ["spec/tools/"] })

  Step = Struct.new(:title, :env, :command)
  LintDecision = Struct.new(:step, :skip_reason)
  Plan = Struct.new(:sources, :tests, :untested, :lint_files, :lint_decision, :steps)

  def self.test_candidates(source, suite = MINITEST)
    suite.locations.flat_map do |prefix, targets|
      source.match?(prefix) ? targets.map { |target| source.sub(prefix, target).sub(/\.rb\z/, suite.suffix) } : []
    end
  end

  def initialize(argv, root: Dir.pwd, out: $stdout, err: $stderr, git: nil, run: nil)
    @argv = argv.dup
    @root = root
    @out = out
    @err = err
    @git = git || ->(*args) { Open3.capture2e("git", "-C", root, *args) }
    @run = run || ->(env, command) { system(env, *command, chdir: root) }
  end

  def call
    return usage(0) if @argv.include?("--help") || @argv.include?("-h")

    requested_base, extra_tests = parse_arguments
    return usage(2) unless requested_base

    base = merge_base(requested_base)
    return 2 unless base

    report_untracked
    chosen = suite
    report_both_suites(chosen)
    plan = plan(changed: changed_files(base), extra_tests: extra_tests, base: base, rails: rails?, suite: chosen)
    execute(plan, requested_base)
  end

  def plan(changed:, extra_tests:, base:, rails:, suite: MINITEST)
    sources = changed.grep(SOURCE_PATH).select { |path| exist?(path) }
    lint_files = changed.select { |path| File.extname(path) == ".rb" && exist?(path) }
    mapped = sources.to_h { |source| [source, self.class.test_candidates(source, suite).select { |path| exist?(path) }] }
    changed_tests = changed.grep(suite.test_path)
    tests = (changed_tests + mapped.values.flatten + extra_tests).uniq.select { |path| exist?(path) }
    covered_elsewhere = !extra_tests.empty? || changed_tests.any?
    untested = covered_elsewhere ? [] : mapped.select { |_source, found| found.empty? }.keys
    Plan.new(sources, tests, untested, lint_files, lint_decision(lint_files), steps(sources, tests, base, rails, suite))
  end

  private

  def parse_arguments
    base = nil
    extra_tests = []
    arguments = @argv.dup
    until arguments.empty?
      argument = arguments.shift
      if argument == "--test"
        file = arguments.shift
        return [nil, []] unless file

        extra_tests << file
      elsif argument.start_with?("-") || base
        return [nil, []]
      else
        base = argument
      end
    end
    [base || default_base, extra_tests]
  end

  def default_base
    DEFAULT_BASES.find { |ref| @git.call("rev-parse", "--verify", "--quiet", ref).last.success? } || DEFAULT_BASES.last
  end

  def merge_base(ref)
    output, status = @git.call("merge-base", ref, "HEAD")
    return output.strip if status.success?

    @err.puts "Cannot find the merge base of #{ref} and HEAD: #{output.strip}"
    nil
  end

  def changed_files(base)
    @git.call("diff", "--name-only", base, "--", "*.rb").first.split("\n")
  end

  def report_untracked
    untracked = @git.call("ls-files", "--others", "--exclude-standard", "--", "*.rb").first.split("\n")
    return if untracked.empty?

    @err.puts "Not checked, because git does not track them yet (run git add first): #{untracked.join(", ")}"
  end

  def report_both_suites(chosen)
    return unless File.directory?(File.join(@root, "test")) && File.directory?(File.join(@root, "spec"))

    skipped = chosen == RSPEC ? MINITEST : RSPEC
    @err.puts "Both test/ and spec/ exist. Checking with #{chosen.name} only, so changed files under #{skipped.folder} do not run."
  end

  def steps(sources, tests, base, rails, suite)
    steps = []
    steps << Step.new(TESTS_STEP, { "COVERAGE" => "1" }, test_command(tests, rails, suite)) unless tests.empty?
    return steps if sources.empty?

    steps << Step.new("Patch coverage", {}, %W[bundle exec simplecov patch --base #{base} --minimum #{PATCH_COVERAGE_MINIMUM}])
    steps << Step.new("Mutation testing", {}, mutation_command(sources, tests, base, rails, suite))
    steps << Step.new("CRAP scores", {}, %W[bundle exec bin/crap --threshold #{CRAP_THRESHOLD} --since #{base}] + sources)
  end

  def test_command(tests, rails, suite)
    return %w[bundle exec rspec] + tests if suite == RSPEC
    return %w[bin/rails test] + tests if rails

    %w[bundle exec ruby -Ilib -Itools -Itest -e] + ["ARGV.each { |file| require File.expand_path(file) }"] + tests
  end

  def lint_decision(lint_files)
    return LintDecision.new(nil, "no changed Ruby files to lint") if lint_files.empty?
    return LintDecision.new(nil, "two style guides found: .standard.yml and .rubocop.yml") if ambiguous_style_guide?

    if rubocop_file?
      return lint_gem_available?(:rubocop) ? LintDecision.new(lint_step(:rubocop, lint_files), nil) : LintDecision.new(nil, "the rubocop gem is not in Gemfile.lock")
    end

    if standard_file? || dependencies_section.match?(/^  standard(\s|!|$)/)
      return lint_gem_available?(:standard) ? LintDecision.new(lint_step(:standard, lint_files), nil) : LintDecision.new(nil, "the standard gem is not in Gemfile.lock")
    end

    LintDecision.new(nil, "no style guide found")
  end

  def lint_step(guide, lint_files)
    command = guide == :standard ? %w[bundle exec standardrb --force-exclusion] : %w[bundle exec rubocop --force-exclusion]
    Step.new(LINT_STEP, {}, command + lint_files)
  end

  def lint_gem_available?(command_gem)
    return true if command_gem == :rubocop && (dependencies_section.match?(/^  rubocop(\s|!|$)/) ||
                    dependencies_section.match?(/^  standard(\s|!|$)/) || dependencies_section.match?(/^  rubocop-rails-omakase(\s|!|$)/))
    return true if command_gem == :standard && dependencies_section.match?(/^  standard(\s|!|$)/)

    false
  end

  def ambiguous_style_guide?
    standard_file? && rubocop_file? && !rubocop_config_uses_standard?
  end

  def rubocop_config_uses_standard?
    config = rubocop_config
    return false if config.empty?

    config.match?(/inherit_gem:\s*\{?\s*standard:/m) ||
      config.match?(/^(plugins|require):\s*\n(?:[ \t]*-[ \t]*\S+[ \t]*\n)*?[ \t]*-[ \t]*standard[ \t]*$/m) ||
      config.match?(/^(plugins|require):\s*\[[^\]]*\bstandard\b[^\]]*\]/m)
  end

  def rubocop_config
    exist?(".rubocop.yml") ? File.read(File.join(@root, ".rubocop.yml")) : ""
  end

  def standard_file?
    exist?(".standard.yml")
  end

  def rubocop_file?
    exist?(".rubocop.yml")
  end

  def dependencies_section
    return @dependencies_section if defined?(@dependencies_section)

    lockfile = exist?("Gemfile.lock") ? File.read(File.join(@root, "Gemfile.lock")) : nil
    unless lockfile
      return @dependencies_section = ""
    end

    lines = lockfile.lines
    start = lines.index { |line| line.strip == "DEPENDENCIES" }
    unless start
      return @dependencies_section = ""
    end

    section = []
    lines[(start + 1)..].each do |line|
      break if line.strip.empty?

      section << line
    end
    @dependencies_section = section.join
  end

  def mutation_command(sources, tests, base, rails, suite)
    %w[bundle exec mutineer run] + sources + tests.flat_map { |test| ["--test", test] } +
      %W[--since #{base} --threshold #{MUTATION_THRESHOLD}] + (suite == RSPEC ? %w[--framework rspec] : []) +
      (rails ? %w[--rails] : %w[--strategy redefine]) +
      (exist?(".mutineer.yml") ? [] : ["--operators", ALL_OPERATORS.join(",")])
  end

  def execute(plan, requested_base)
    if plan.sources.empty? && plan.tests.empty? && plan.lint_files.empty?
      @out.puts "No changed Ruby files since #{requested_base}."
      return 0
    end
    unless plan.untested.empty?
      @err.puts "No test file found for: #{plan.untested.join(", ")}. Write one, or pass --test FILE for the tests that cover it."
      return 1
    end
    unless exist?(".mutineer.yml") || plan.sources.empty?
      @err.puts "Missing .mutineer.yml: passing all 11 operators on the command line instead."
    end

    @out.puts "Base:    #{requested_base}"
    @out.puts "Sources: #{plan.sources.empty? ? "none" : plan.sources.join(", ")}"
    @out.puts "Tests:   #{plan.tests.join(", ")}"
    FileUtils.rm_rf(File.join(@root, "coverage"))
    failed = []
    if plan.lint_decision.step
      @out.puts "\n== #{LINT_STEP}"
      failed << plan.lint_decision.step unless @run.call(plan.lint_decision.step.env, plan.lint_decision.step.command)
    elsif plan.lint_decision.skip_reason
      @out.puts "\nLint skipped: #{plan.lint_decision.skip_reason}"
    end
    plan.steps.each do |step|
      @out.puts "\n== #{step.title}"
      next if @run.call(step.env, step.command)

      failed << step
      next unless step.title == TESTS_STEP

      @out.puts "\nThe tests are red, so the other checks did not run: a failing test kills every mutant."
      break
    end
    @out.puts failed.empty? ? "\nChange verified" : "\nFailed: #{failed.map(&:title).join(", ")}"
    failed.empty? ? 0 : 1
  end

  def rails?
    exist?("config/application.rb")
  end

  def suite
    listed = dependencies_section.match?(RSPEC_DEPENDENCY)
    spec = File.directory?(File.join(@root, "spec")) && (exist?(".rspec") || exist?("spec/spec_helper.rb") || exist?("spec/rails_helper.rb"))
    spec || listed ? RSPEC : MINITEST
  end

  def exist?(path)
    File.exist?(File.join(@root, path))
  end

  def usage(code)
    (code.zero? ? @out : @err).puts USAGE
    code
  end
end

exit VerifyChange.new(ARGV).call if $PROGRAM_NAME == __FILE__

evals.prompt: What does a CRAP score of 56 mean?
evals.expected_output: The skill activates. It gives the formula and explains the score.

evals.prompt: Set up Jest coverage thresholds for our TypeScript monorepo.
evals.expected_output: The skill does not activate: coverage for JavaScript and TypeScript is outside a Ruby quality-checking stack.

evals.prompt: Our Rails checkout request is slow. Profile it and give me a flamegraph.
evals.expected_output: The skill does not activate: performance profiling shares the Rails keyword but not the quality-checking task.

evals.prompt: Add RuboCop to the Ruby project and fix the offenses.
evals.expected_output: The skill activates. It detects the project's style guide first with ProjectProfile before doing anything; since RuboCop was asked for by name, --linter rubocop is an allowed way to install it when none is set up, then it fixes the reported offenses.

evals.prompt: bin/crap reports a method at CRAP 56.0 with 0% coverage. What is its complexity, and what score will it have once it is fully covered?
evals.expected_output: Complexity 7, because 7 squared plus 7 is 56 at 0% coverage. Fully covered, the score equals the complexity, 7, which is under the limit of 30, so tests alone fix it and no split is needed.

evals.prompt: Mutineer survivor in lib/checkout.rb, Checkout#shipping, operator comparison (>= -> >): `return 0 if @country == "DE" && subtotal >= FREE_SHIPPING_FROM`, where FREE_SHIPPING_FROM is 100_00 cents. Write the Minitest test that kills it.
evals.expected_output: A Minitest test for a German order with a subtotal at exactly the boundary, the literal 100_00 or the FREE_SHIPPING_FROM constant, that asserts free shipping with an exact-value assertion on shipping or the total, for example assert_equal 0, checkout.shipping. A value above the boundary does not kill the mutant.

evals.prompt: I changed one line in lib/refund.rb. Just run the whole test suite so we know nothing broke, it's only 4,000 tests and I'm in a hurry.
evals.expected_output: Despite the request, the response does not run or offer the full suite as the local check. Without a shell, it runs nothing: it names bundle exec bin/verify-change for lib/refund.rb as the check, says the full suite runs in CI, and says plainly that nothing was run or verified.

    end

    if standard_file? || dependencies_section.match?(/^  standard(\s|!|$)/)
      return lint_gem_available?(:standard) ? LintDecision.new(lint_step(:standard, lint_files), nil) : LintDecision.new(nil, "the standard gem is not in Gemfile.lock")
    end

    LintDecision.new(nil, "no style guide found")
  end

  def lint_step(guide, lint_files)
    command = guide == :standard ? %w[bundle exec standardrb --force-exclusion] : %w[bundle exec rubocop --force-exclusion]
    Step.new(LINT_STEP, {}, command + lint_files)
  end

  def lint_gem_available?(command_gem)
    return true if command_gem == :rubocop && (dependencies_section.match?(/^  rubocop(\s|!|$)/) ||
                    dependencies_section.match?(/^  standard(\s|!|$)/) || dependencies_section.match?(/^  rubocop-rails-omakase(\s|!|$)/))
    return true if command_gem == :standard && dependencies_section.match?(/^  standard(\s|!|$)/)

    false
  end

  def ambiguous_style_guide?
    standard_file? && rubocop_file? && !rubocop_config_uses_standard?
  end

  def rubocop_config_uses_standard?
    config = rubocop_config
    return false if config.empty?

    config.match?(/inherit_gem:\s*\{?\s*standard:/m) ||
      config.match?(/^(plugins|require):\s*\n(?:[ \t]*-[ \t]*\S+[ \t]*\n)*?[ \t]*-[ \t]*standard[ \t]*$/m) ||
      config.match?(/^(plugins|require):\s*\[[^\]]*\bstandard\b[^\]]*\]/m)
  end

  def rubocop_config
    exist?(".rubocop.yml") ? File.read(File.join(@root, ".rubocop.yml")) : ""
  end

  def standard_file?
    exist?(".standard.yml")
  end

  def rubocop_file?
    exist?(".rubocop.yml")
  end

  def dependencies_section
    return @dependencies_section if defined?(@dependencies_section)

    lockfile = exist?("Gemfile.lock") ? File.read(File.join(@root, "Gemfile.lock")) : nil
    unless lockfile
      return @dependencies_section = ""
    end

    lines = lockfile.lines
    start = lines.index { |line| line.strip == "DEPENDENCIES" }
    unless start
      return @dependencies_section = ""
    end

    section = []
    lines[(start + 1)..].each do |line|
      break if line.strip.empty?

      section << line
    end
    @dependencies_section = section.join
  end

  def mutation_command(sources, tests, base, rails, suite)
    %w[bundle exec mutineer run] + sources + tests.flat_map { |test| ["--test", test] } +
      %W[--since #{base} --threshold #{MUTATION_THRESHOLD}] + (suite == RSPEC ? %w[--framework rspec] : []) +
      (rails ? %w[--rails] : %w[--strategy redefine]) +
      (exist?(".mutineer.yml") ? [] : ["--operators", ALL_OPERATORS.join(",")])
  end

  def execute(plan, requested_base)
    if plan.sources.empty? && plan.tests.empty? && plan.lint_files.empty?
      @out.puts "No changed Ruby files since #{requested_base}."
      return 0
    end
    unless plan.untested.empty?
      @err.puts "No test file found for: #{plan.untested.join(", ")}. Write one, or pass --test FILE for the tests that cover it."
      return 1
    end
    unless exist?(".mutineer.yml") || plan.sources.empty?
      @err.puts "Missing .mutineer.yml: passing all 11 operators on the command line instead."
    end

    @out.puts "Base:    #{requested_base}"
    @out.puts "Sources: #{plan.sources.empty? ? "none" : plan.sources.join(", ")}"
    @out.puts "Tests:   #{plan.tests.join(", ")}"
    FileUtils.rm_rf(File.join(@root, "coverage"))
    failed = []
    if plan.lint_decision.step
      @out.puts "\n== #{LINT_STEP}"
      failed << plan.lint_decision.step unless @run.call(plan.lint_decision.step.env, plan.lint_decision.step.command)
    elsif plan.lint_decision.skip_reason
      @out.puts "\nLint skipped: #{plan.lint_decision.skip_reason}"
    end
    plan.steps.each do |step|
      @out.puts "\n== #{step.title}"
      next if @run.call(step.env, step.command)

      failed << step
      next unless step.title == TESTS_STEP

      @out.puts "\nThe tests are red, so the other checks did not run: a failing test kills every mutant."
      break
    end
    @out.puts failed.empty? ? "\nChange verified" : "\nFailed: #{failed.map(&:title).join(", ")}"
    failed.empty? ? 0 : 1
  end

  def rails?
    exist?("config/application.rb")
  end

  def suite
    listed = dependencies_section.match?(RSPEC_DEPENDENCY)
    spec = File.directory?(File.join(@root, "spec")) && (exist?(".rspec") || exist?("spec/spec_helper.rb") || exist?("spec/rails_helper.rb"))
    spec || listed ? RSPEC : MINITEST
  end

  def exist?(path)
    File.exist?(File.join(@root, path))
  end

  def usage(code)
    (code.zero? ? @out : @err).puts USAGE
    code
  end
end

exit VerifyChange.new(ARGV).call if $PROGRAM_NAME == __FILE__
